summary: On a real slow line the TV is an empty glowing screen until its ~74 KB script arrives (slow-3G phone: painted 2.7 s, list 9.9 s; fast 3G 0.9 -> 3.0 s; slow-3G laptop: list 16.4 s, picture 21 s), and in that window its invisible rows are live links (a tap leaves for a product page) and the laptop's Try key is dead; a failed script chunk leaves the TV empty for good. Laptops also fetch all five plugin pictures up front (1.24 MB vs 0.46 MB on a phone). Once loaded, taps, quick switching, the sign-up (slow / down) and Back behave; the numbers are the site's own files only (third parties aborted by the kit).

how_measured: Every run = its own fresh Playwright browser (cold cache) through ../helper.cjs; numbers are medians of 3 runs unless "runs" says otherwise; page clock = ms from navigation start.

The site's own files only: the kit aborts every third party at once (cdn.paddle.com/paddle/v2/paddle.js and static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js on every load; after "Accept All" the page would also load connect.facebook.net fbevents.js and googletagmanager.com gtag.js). What a slow third party does: metrics.third_party and finding N7.

Chromium throttling = DevTools presets (calibrated below); it shares the line evenly between requests and ignores HTTP/2 priorities, so the script's arrival on slow 3G is pessimistic (with ideal priorities the HTML + CSS + fonts + script, ~210 KB, need ~4.5-5.5 s). WebKit: 150 ms per request, no bandwidth cap.

The preview server gzips like GitHub Pages but sends Cache-Control: no-cache and Vary: Origin. Playwright routing disables the HTTP cache and Chromium runs with bfcache off, so Back was measured both under the kit and with the kit's route dropped (back3.cjs: other hosts fail DNS, nothing leaves the Mac). bfcache itself could not be exercised: even a control page reports notRestoredReasons "masked" in this headless Chromium.

The Mac was heavily loaded by the other lanes (load average 18 -> 140 during the runs): CPU-bound numbers (long tasks) vary; one 12 s long task on a laptop fast-3G run did not reproduce and is left out.
Phone CLS: Chrome's mobile emulation flags the shifts as "after input" although nothing was touched (probe-input.cjs), so it reports ~0; cls.all_shifts is the real-phone score.

tested: Throttling really applies (a 290,662-byte file): slow 3G 6.2 s, fast 3G 1.6 s, 4G 0.32 s (the DevTools presets), WebKit +150 ms per request.
No page errors and no 4xx/5xx from the site in any run (the only 404s are the ones forced in N5); console: only the two aborted third parties.

Once the script has run, a tap on a row opens its pane in 0.34-0.70 s on every phone profile; a laptop click on Try opens the sign-up in 0.2-0.4 s; the phone's Try opens it in 0.6-1.1 s on slow 3G + 4x CPU.

Quick switching while pictures load (laptop GAS -> Radio Roulette -> GAS 2, phone GAS -> DRIFT -> Radio Roulette, ~250 ms apart, slow 3G): never two plugins on the glass, never a picture on the wrong plugin, the last pick wins, lit row = panel = ?plugin=.
DRIFT's video never loads up front (preload none); on a phone none of the five big pictures load until a pane opens (one per pane).
Sign-up, worker slow (4 s): "Sending..." within 0.1-0.3 s, the second tap of a double tap sends nothing (1 post), "Check your inbox" with the address after ~4.1-4.4 s (phone slow 3G, WebKit, laptop).
Sign-up, worker down: "Network hiccup. Try again in a moment." within ~0.1-0.3 s, the email kept, the key back; each retry posts once.

Back from a product page with the browser's HTTP cache (slow 3G phone): the TV comes back with RevLimiter's pane open, lit, scroll where it was, in ~1.5 s; 4G ~0.5 s; WebKit ~1 s (under the kit, which disables the cache, a slow-3G Back is a full re-download and takes > 9 s: harness only).

Fonts: font-display swap, both faces preloaded; Bebas lands before the first paint on slow 3G (2.3 s vs 2.7 s); Inter's swap at ~5.6 s moves the laptop's lit text a few px (shift 0.0018); nothing in the phone's TV uses Inter before its script. No unstyled flash (the CSS blocks rendering).

CLS under 0.1 everywhere: phone 0.078 (the category bar appearing at script time pushes the still-hidden list 78 px down), laptop 0.03. LCP (the wood wall behind the TV): phone 0.42 s 4G, 1.7 s fast 3G, 6.0 s slow 3G; laptop 0.48 / 1.96 / 6.1 s.
Long tasks on a 4x-slowed phone: 2, max ~290 ms (module start) and ~190 ms (cabinet up); none at 1x.
The cookie banner never arrives after the list (up at 1.0 / 1.7 / 3.5 s, before or with it), so it never lands under a finger aimed at a row.

WebKit's double download of the two preloaded fonts here comes from the preview server's "Vary: Origin": with "Vary: Accept-Encoding" (GitHub Pages' header) the preload is reused (2/2), so not a site issue.

findings.title: The TV is an empty screen until its JavaScript arrives: the site-wide reveal pre-hide keeps the rows (and on a laptop the lit picture) invisible
findings.where: chromium + webkit, every profile; phone-390 and laptop-1280 (worst on slow 3G)
steps: Cold load / on slow 3G + 4x CPU at 390x664 (Chromium)
Watch the TV from its first paint (screenshots at 3, 6, 10 s); repeat at fast 3G, 4G, WebKit and at 1280x665
findings.expected: The plugin list (and on a laptop the lit plugin's picture) is on the glass as soon as the TV paints; the script only adds behaviour.
findings.actual: html.motion-ok [data-reveal-item]:not(.revealed){opacity:0} hides the five rows, and data-reveal="card" hides the laptop's lit picture, until the hoisted module runs initReveals. That module is an 11 KB file which then imports a 62 KB chunk (no modulepreload, so the chunk is only requested after the first file arrives, ~3 s on slow 3G). Medians: phone slow 3G: TV painted 2.75 s, list shown 9.9 s (7.2 s of glowing glass with only "PLUGINS"; the thumbnails are loaded at 8.6 s but hidden); fast 3G 0.92 -> 3.0 s; 4G 0.26 -> 1.12 s; WebKit 150 ms 0.49 -> 1.21 s. Laptop slow 3G: rows 16.4 s, lit picture 21.0 s (13.6 s showing only RevLimiter's text and keys); laptop fast 3G: rows 3.5 s, picture 5.5 s. Control: with reduced motion (no pre-hide) the same slow-3G list is on show at 2.8 s.
findings.repro: 3/3 per profile (2/2 for the reduced-motion control)
findings.fix_idea: Keep the TV out of the reveal pre-hide (it has its own power-on), or give the pre-hide a CSS-only time-out; add <link rel="modulepreload"> for the shared chunk; load the below-the-TV bytes (N13) after it.

findings.title: A tap on the empty TV while it loads leaves for a product page (the invisible rows are live links)
findings.where: chromium phone-390 slow 3G / fast 3G / 4G, laptop-1280 slow 3G; webkit phone-390 (150 ms) once in 2
steps: Cold load on slow 3G at 390x664
At 3 s, 6 s or 8 s (TV painted, script not there yet) tap where GAS's row sits: the glass looks empty
findings.expected: Nothing happens, or the TV takes the tap once ready; never a page change from something the visitor cannot see.
findings.actual: Until the script turns them into tabs the rows are plain <a href="/gas"> links, and opacity 0 does not stop a tap: the browser opens /gas. Phone slow 3G: 3, 6, 8 s -> /gas; 10 s -> GAS's pane opens (0.52 s). Fast 3G: 1, 2 s -> /gas; 3 s OK. 4G: 0.4 s -> /gas; 1 s OK. Laptop slow 3G: 3, 6, 10, 13 s -> /gas (script at 15.7 s). WebKit 150 ms: at ~0.6-1.0 s once /gas, once nothing. (With reduced motion the rows are visible from 2.8 s and act as links: expected.)
findings.code_ref: src/components/WordWall.astro:241-246 (rows are links), 1554-1577 (the click handler that makes them tabs)
findings.fix_idea: Same root as N1: show the rows from the first paint (a link that is seen may act as one), or keep them pointer-events:none while they are hidden.

findings.title: Laptop: the Try key is on show from the first paint but does nothing until the script lands
findings.where: chromium laptop-1280, slow 3G and fast 3G (+4x CPU)
steps: Cold load at 1280x665 on slow 3G
Click "TRY FREE FOR 30 DAYS" at 3, 6, 10 or 13 s
findings.expected: The sign-up opens, or the key is not offered until it works.
findings.actual: Try is a <button type="button"> whose only listeners live in the module: no sign-up, no pop-up, nothing. Slow 3G: dead at 3/6/10/13 s (script median 15.7 s, so ~13 s of a dead main key); fast 3G: dead at 2 s, opens the sign-up at 4 s (script median 2.9 s). Phones are not affected (their keys are in the pane the script opens). After a failed script chunk (N5) it stays dead.
findings.fix_idea: Give Try a no-script destination (e.g. a link to the product page's trial) that the script takes over, or show it only once the TV is ready.

findings.title: Laptop: all five plugin pictures load up front, the hidden panels' too, and starve the TV on a slow line
steps: Cold load at 1280x665 on slow 3G, no interaction
Watch the requests
findings.expected: Only the lit plugin's picture for the first screen; the others after the power-on (warm(), as the code intends) or when lit.
findings.actual: Inactive panels are hidden with opacity:0 + visibility:hidden in the same grid cell, so their loading="lazy" pictures count as on screen and start at the first paint (2.8 s): GAS 152 KB, GAS 2 157 KB, Radio Roulette 198 KB (507 KB hidden) next to RevLimiter's 135 KB; DRIFT's poster (49 KB) follows at the power-on. 1240 KB in 30 s on a laptop vs 456 KB on a phone. On slow 3G they share the line with the script and the lit picture: script 15.7 s (phone 9.6 s), RevLimiter's picture half drawn at 20 s and complete at 21.0 s, cabinet 26.3 s. WebKit fetches them too (all at 0.75 s). DRIFT's video is not fetched up front (preload none): good.
findings.fix_idea: display:none (or content-visibility:hidden) for the panels not on the glass, or give their its src only in warm() / light(): about 0.5 MB less on every desktop first load.

findings.title: If the TV's script chunk fails to load, the TV stays empty for good
findings.where: chromium phone-390 + laptop-1280 (4G), the 62 KB chunk aborted / 404
steps: Load / with /_astro/hoisted.De0NW6Lt.js failing (a dropped mobile request, or a page cached from before a deploy asking for a chunk the deploy removed)
Look at the TV after 8 s; tap a row; on a laptop click Try
findings.expected: The TV falls back to its no-script look (a visible list of links) within a few seconds.
findings.actual: The inline head script has already set html.motion-ok, and the 2.5 s reveal fallback lives in the same failed module: rows and the lit picture stay at opacity 0 for good (only "PLUGINS" on the glass), a tap on the empty glass opens /gas, the laptop's Try does nothing. Nothing tells the visitor anything went wrong.
findings.fix_idea: A CSS-only time-out on the pre-hide (an animation that reveals after ~3 s), or drop motion-ok from an inline timer if the module has not started by then.

findings.title: Lighting a plugin on a slow line: its window stays blank or half drawn for seconds (no placeholder)
steps: Slow 3G; wait until the list is up (~10 s phone, ~16 s laptop)
Tap GAS 2 or DRIFT (phone), click GAS (laptop)
findings.expected: Something in the window at once: the row's thumbnail (already loaded) blurred, or a placeholder.
findings.actual: The pane comes on in 0.5-0.8 s with an empty window. Phone GAS 2: bare glass until the picture completes at +4.5-4.8 s. Phone DRIFT: an empty dark box until its poster at +3.3 s, the run playing at +4.1 s. Laptop GAS: only the top half drawn, complete at +6.1-6.7 s. No broken-image icons. Quick switching stayed clean (see tested).
findings.code_ref: src/components/WordWall.astro:1077-1089 (the newcomer waits at most 150 ms for its decode)
findings.fix_idea: Put the row's loaded thumbnail behind the window as its placeholder; or a lighter first cut when navigator.connection says the line is slow.

findings.title: A slow analytics beacon holds back the whole TV (it runs before the TV's script)
findings.where: chromium phone-390 4G; the third parties answered locally after 6 s
steps: Answer static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js after 6 s (the kit normally aborts it at once)
Load /
findings.expected: The TV never waits for analytics.
findings.actual: The beacon is a <script defer> in the head BEFORE the TV's module; deferred and module scripts run in document order, so the TV's script ran at 6.15 s instead of ~0.55 s and the list showed at 6.8 s. paddle.js (defer, after the module) does not hold the TV, but holds DOMContentLoaded / load until it arrives, so the cabinet waited for its 3 s fallback (3.7 s instead of 0.8 s).
findings.fix_idea: async on the beacon (or move it to the end of the body).

findings.title: Sign-up on a stalled line: "Sending..." forever, and still stuck after Back and Try again
findings.where: chromium phone-390, slow 3G (+ 4G for the reopen); the worker never answers
steps: Open RevLimiter's pane, Try, type an email, tick the terms, Send
The licence worker never answers (a stalled mobile connection)
Wait 25 s; then tap Back and Try again
findings.expected: After ~15 s the "Network hiccup" message and the key back, so the visitor can try again.
findings.actual: postJson has no time-out: after 25 s the key still reads "SENDING..." and is disabled, with no message. Back and Try again reopens the form still "SENDING..." and disabled (the busy flag is per form); a tap does nothing (one post in total). Only a reload frees it.
findings.fix_idea: An AbortController time-out (~15 s) in postJson; on time-out show the "Network hiccup" line and re-enable the key.

findings.title: Laptop: a link to one plugin shows RevLimiter until the script runs, and its keys lead to RevLimiter
findings.where: chromium laptop-1280 slow 3G (and every Back / reload on a laptop, briefly)
steps: Open /?plugin=gas cold on slow 3G (a shared link; also where Back from a product page lands)
At 4.5 s look at the lit panel; click "Product page ->"
findings.expected: GAS is lit from the first paint (or nothing is lit until the script).
findings.actual: The HTML always lights the first plugin and ?plugin= is applied by the module: at 4.5 s the TV shows RevLimiter (name, $49, Try, Product page) and Product page opens /revlimiter. It stays wrong until the script (median 15.7 s slow 3G, 2.9 s fast 3G); on Back with the HTTP cache RevLimiter shows for ~0.5-1 s before GAS. Phones show the list first, so they are not affected.
findings.code_ref: src/components/WordWall.astro:242,267 (first plugin lit in the HTML), 1511-1528 (fromUrl in the module)
findings.fix_idea: A few inline lines right after the TV markup that read ?plugin= and move is-active / is-lit / data-ww-on before the first paint.

findings.title: When the script lands late, the already-lit glass blacks out and powers on again
steps: Cold load on slow 3G
Watch the glass when the list appears (~9.5 s)
findings.expected: The power-on plays on arrival, or not at all once the TV has been on show.
findings.actual: The glass glows from the first paint (2.7 s). When the script arrives it arms the power-on (glow opacity 0) at 9.53 s, then plays the 700 ms CRT turn-on: a ~150 ms black-out and a re-light ~7 s after the visitor started looking (glow per frame: 1.00 -> 0.00 at 9532 ms -> powering 9684 ms -> on 10452 ms). On 4G the same happens ~0.25 s after the first paint.
findings.fix_idea: Go straight to "on" when the TV has already been painted for more than ~0.5 s, or arm the power-on from the first paint.

findings.title: First visit on a 390x664 phone: the cookie banner covers the last row and every pane's Product page key
steps: First visit (no cookie choice yet)
Look at the list, then open any plugin's pane
findings.expected: The TV's keys reachable without answering the banner (P04: slim on phones, keys clear).
findings.actual: The banner (115 px, y 549-664) is up at 1.0 / 1.7 / 3.5 s on 4G / fast 3G / slow 3G: never late, it arrives before or with the list. But it stays over the TV: Radio Roulette's row 67 of 74 px under it (its centre covered); in all five panes "Product page ->" (y 582-619) is hidden completely and Try's bottom 2-22 px. scroll-padding-bottom only helps keyboard focus.
findings.fix_idea: A one-line banner on phones while the TV is in view, or the pane's keys lifted clear of it.

findings.title: The TV's cabinet pops in late (WebKit ~3.8 s even on a quick line)
findings.where: chromium slow 3G; webkit phone-390 + laptop-1280 at 150 ms
steps: Cold load
Note when the cabinet frame appears around the glass
findings.expected: The cabinet with or soon after the TV.
findings.actual: The frame waits for the load event (or the first scroll, or 3 s after the script). Phone slow 3G 11.5 s (1.5 s after the list), laptop slow 3G 26.3 s. WebKit fires load ~3.5 s in on a quick line (Chromium 4G: 0.6 s), so the cabinet comes at 3.8 s there; not DRIFT's video and not the blocked third parties (both ruled out), cause not found: worth a look on a real iPhone.
findings.fix_idea: Start the frame on DOMContentLoaded + the IntersectionObserver instead of load, or shorten the 3 s fallback.

findings.title: Bytes that are not for the first screen load with it and share the line with the TV's script
steps: Cold load on slow 3G
Read the request list before the script lands (9.6 s)
findings.expected: The first seconds of a slow line spent on the TV.
findings.actual: Before the TV's script: the haze plates 66 KB (smoke at 10-16 % opacity), VT323 18 KB (only the DAW strip under the TV), Oswald 21 KB (pulled only by the "▸" after "Pick a category", which Bebas lacks; in WebKit the ▸ is blank until it lands), the subscribe pop-up's pressed-button image 11 KB (requested at 0.6 s), DAW logos 5 KB: ~120 KB, ~2.4 s of a slow-3G line next to the TV's ~74 KB of script. GAS 2's list thumbnail is 33 KB, 2-3x the other four.
findings.fix_idea: Load the haze plates and the pop-up's art after load; take Oswald out of --font-display (or give Bebas the ▸); a lighter GAS 2 thumbnail.
